result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, largely absolute phrasing ('highest priority', 'highest ethical standards', 'always'). Opens with a vision of being most admired for people, partnership and performance. Uses first-person plural throughout. Safety and integrity are emphasized heavily; shareholder value appears in the strategy section, framed around results and returns.
